next.reason: 1985 GR14: in sequential access records 'must be released ... in ascending order of prime record key values according to the collating sequence of the file'; in extend mode the first record must have a prime key 'greater than the highest prime record key value existing in the file'. 2023 §2023:14.9.51.4 GR38 states both, adds that later extend records exceed the highest written (the ascending-order duty already implies it) and states the result (unsuccessful, invalid key, status '21'), which 1985 gave in GR17a and GR18. Same.
